metadata.title: Shareholder Register
metadata.description: Official Shareholder Register, updated and error-free. Stop using inefficient Excel sheets. A single shareholder register ready to submit to the Registry and to easily calculate operations.
metadata.keywords: Shareholder Register, Shareholders, Registry, Operations, Excel

hero.title: Digital shareholder register, with numbered share ranges and up-to-date certificates
hero.description: Sttok lets the company keep its register of partners or of registered shares by recording every transaction. Each transfer is recorded against numbered ranges, with its encumbrances and co-owners, and the register is generated automatically and exported in a format ready for legalisation.

setup.title: The register comes from the transactions, not from a spreadsheet
setup.lede: Sttok does not copy a list of shareholders: it rebuilds the company's history transaction by transaction. Each share has its number, its history and the documents behind it.

steps.title: Every transaction, since incorporation
steps.text: The company's transactions are recorded one after another since incorporation, such as capital increases, sales, inheritances or renumberings, each with its deed, minutes or agreement. Sttok reads the documents with AI and proposes each transaction.

steps.title: Or from a checkpoint
steps.text: If not all the documents are available, the starting point is the share capital on a known date: five or ten years ago, or the last renumbering of the shares. The later transactions are recorded from there.

steps.title: The register and records are generated
steps.text: With the transactions recorded, Sttok generates the register with the history of each share by its number, and fills in each shareholder's record: ranges, transactions, encumbrances and documents.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions about the shareholder register

items.q: Can Sttok be used to keep the official shareholder register?
items.a: Yes. Sttok lets the company keep its register of partners or of registered shares: with every transaction recorded, the register is generated up to date and exported in a format ready for legalisation. Keeping it remains the responsibility of the governing body, and it can be filed electronically with the Companies Registry from Sttok, when the company decides to.

items.q: Can I migrate the register from Excel?
items.a: Yes. Migration is part of setup, which takes a few hours per company. If years are missing, the history is rebuilt from the deeds in a few minutes.

items.q: Does it handle numbering, classes and encumbrances?
items.a: Yes. Every share has its number and class. Pledge, usufruct, bare ownership, co-ownership and options are kept as separate positions.
Yes. Each shareholder logs in with their email address and sees their shares, their ranges and their documents, including their certificates. The portal also gives access to the meetings.

items.q: Does it work for a public limited company (SA)?
items.a: Yes. For an SA it is used to keep the register of registered shares, with the same numbering, classes and encumbrances.

items.q: Does it work for companies in Latin America?
items.a: The platform adapts to each country's terminology: shareholder ledger, general shareholders' meeting, board of directors. Compliance with each country's regulations is assessed case by case.

situations.title: Common situations with the shareholder register

rows.situation: The shareholder register is not up to date
rows.action: It is the usual case when it lives in a spreadsheet nobody updates. In Sttok each transaction is recorded with its documents and the register is generated automatically, always up to date.

rows.situation: A shareholder asks for a certificate for wealth tax or income tax
rows.action: It is generated from the register on the date requested, with the year's transactions and any encumbrances, for one shareholder or for all of them at once.

rows.situation: A shareholder sells part of their shares
rows.action: The transfer is recorded against the specific ranges and both positions are updated.
The inheritance is recorded, the share numbers are split among the heirs and co-ownership is set up with its representative.

rows.situation: A usufruct or a pledge is created
rows.action: The bare owner's and the usufructuary's positions are kept apart, or the pledge is recorded on the ranges affected.

rows.situation: The register is years out of date
rows.action: It is rebuilt from the deeds in a few minutes, with any gaps in the history flagged.

rows.situation: The register has to be legalised
rows.action: It is exported in the format filed with the Companies Registry.
